title: View All Publications
publisher: Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka (TRI)
summary: Portal indexing many TRI publications (advisory circulars, guidelines, reports). Best entry-point for a Sri Lanka–specific tea corpus.
license_notes: Assume copyright unless an explicit license is stated on the site or inside each PDF. Check PDF front matter + site terms.

title: Guidelines on Plucking (TRI Advisory Circular HP 04/03)
publisher: Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka (TRI)
summary: Official plucking guidance (shoot standards, plucking rounds, quality impacts).
license_notes: Likely copyrighted; verify in-PDF and TRI site terms.

title: Suitability of Tea Clones for Different Regions (TRI Advisory Circular PN 01)
publisher: Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka (TRI)
summary: Clone/region suitability guidance (useful for cultivar-by-region knowledge).
license_notes: Likely copyrighted; verify in-PDF and TRI site terms.

title: Chemical Control of Diseases (TRI Advisory Circular PU 03/11)
publisher: Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka (TRI)
summary: TRI’s official chemical disease control guidance for tea (active ingredients, practices, constraints).
license_notes: Likely copyrighted; verify in-PDF and repository terms.

title: Pesticide Use (TRI circular / guidance; repository PDF)
publisher: Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka (TRI)
summary: TRI guidance on pesticide usage with residue-compliance context (MRLs).
license_notes: Assume copyrighted unless stated; check PDF + repository terms.

title: Guidelines for Establishment of Tea to Facilitate Mechanization (TRISL Guideline 03/2019)
publisher: Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka (TRI)
summary: Field/estate establishment guidance enabling mechanized operations (layout, planting, management).

title: Factors in Tea Manufacture (TRI technical monograph; repository PDF)
publisher: Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka (TRI)
summary: Technical content on tea manufacture factors and their impacts on quality.
license_notes: Assume copyrighted unless stated; check PDF + repository terms.

title: Tea Statistics
summary: Official Sri Lanka Tea Board statistics portal (production/sales/export/price series).
license_notes: Check SLTB site terms for reuse; for RAG citations, store snapshots/PDF exports where possible.

title: Monthly Tea Statistics – June 2022 (example in SLTB monthly series)
summary: Structured monthly statistical tables (repeatable format; good for grounding numeric answers).
license_notes: Likely copyrighted; check PDF + SLTB terms.

title: Revised Tea Production 2024 (Monthly)
summary: Monthly production breakdowns for 2024; useful for trend and verification questions.
license_notes: Likely copyrighted; check PDF + SLTB terms.

title: Sri Lanka Tea Board Standards for Sri Lankan Origin Teas
summary: Minimum quality standards and compliance framing (aligns to ISO black tea requirements).
license_notes: Likely copyrighted; check PDF + SLTB terms.

title: Sri Lanka Tea Board Standards for Sri Lankan Origin Teas (compressed/annex pack)
summary: Operational standards pack; often includes residue/MRL-related annexures and references to TRI guidance.
license_notes: Likely copyrighted; check PDF + SLTB terms.

title: Specification – Ceylon tea
summary: Defines Ceylon tea identity, geography/altitude context, processing/quality expectations and branding rules.
license_notes: Likely copyrighted; check PDF + SLTB terms.

title: DSLS-GAP-TEA (Draft Sri Lanka Standard: Good Agricultural Practices – Tea)
publisher: Sri Lanka government / standards draft (hosted on Plantation & Community Infrastructure Ministry site)
summary: Draft GAP requirements across tea cultivation and handling; useful for compliance language and best-practice checklists.
license_notes: Draft states copyright reserved. Use for citation/quoting carefully; don’t redistribute without permission.
stability: Medium-High (gov domain, but draft docs can move)

title: UN Comtrade+ TradeFlow (HS 0902 Tea)
summary: Authoritative global trade flows; supports Sri Lanka tea export/import series by partner, product code, and time.
license_notes: Use Comtrade’s license/terms; store terms page + citation format in your repo.
